The Virtual Marketer

30 December 2022 · Virtual Marketer Team

The Virtual Marketer is a tool developed by marketers, programmers, and data scientists from Germany, in the form of a virtual marketing assistant that enables companies to handle many of the regular tasks of a marketing employee. The Virtual Marketer is capable of generating Facebook and Google Ads copy (paid and organic), checking keywords, writing category texts, drafting product descriptions, rewriting texts, coming up with ideas for blog posts and even formulating entire blog posts, assisting with the development of formulas, and much more. That is already impressive, though not unique — many well-known companies and projects such as ChatGPT from OpenAI, Jasper, Anyword, and Copy.ai have also developed AI assistants of varying quality.

What really makes the Virtual Marketer unique?

Unlike most other AI assistants, the Virtual Marketer speaks perfect German and is provided by a German-speaking team, allowing it to easily distinguish between the formal "Sie" and informal "Du" forms of address, where many others already fail. But the real trump card is that the Virtual Marketer is trained specifically for your company. If you decide to deploy the Virtual Marketer in your company, you will discuss during personal onboarding with one of the Virtual Marketer's data scientists and marketers what goals your company has and which tasks at your company could be taken over by the Virtual Marketer. At this point, you can also provide your own data, such as your existing texts, which are then used to train the Virtual Marketer to be perfectly tailored to your needs.

(Unique) Content is King — BUT — Time is Money. A Conflict?

Not with the Virtual Marketer. The Virtual Marketer is a game changer for large companies that need to remain 100% scalable and 100% individual, mid-sized companies that want to hold their own in the market, and up-and-coming companies that cannot yet afford an expensive marketing team. With the Virtual Marketer, companies can organize their marketing campaigns and many other tasks independently and efficiently, automate countless tasks individually, and thereby not only save a lot of money but also find time to focus on the truly important things and strategic topics.

Yet Another Piece of Software?

No. The Virtual Marketer is built entirely API-first — meaning it can be integrated into your existing tools and helps exactly where it is needed, without the need to install new software. For example, you can simply bring it in as an add-on to your spreadsheets from major providers like Google Sheets, or even integrate it into your own custom-built software with just a single API request. This makes the Virtual Marketer a simple and effective solution for companies that want to optimize their marketing and get ready for the age of AI.
